task.instruction: Synthesize evidence for a learning dashboard serving several programs while one high-risk program drives most support work.
task.deliverable: An analytical synthesis, invariant denominator rule, and cited evidence.

evidence.content: Across that advanced program, failures cluster at one simulation step, but two small programs lack any diagnostic detail.
A synthetic completion-definition rule calculates completion only among enrolled participants who started; diagnostic depth cannot change that denominator.
Synthetic data cover seven programs with moderate completion differences; one advanced program generates 54% of support contacts.

A.content: When coverage is the limiting need, represent the important range of cases before adding detail to any one case.

B.content: When understanding is the limiting need, examine the pivotal case deeply before extending coverage.

irrelevant.content: Use consistent spacing between sections in the final artifact.
